review.finding: validate_triage_counts(recorded_triage: dict, keys) takes an untyped `keys` param that reads as a collection of key names, but the only call site passes expected_counts (a dict), relying on Python's implicit dict-iterates-keys behavior. Works correctly, but a reader could expect a list of key names.
review.suggestion: Type-hint as Iterable[str] or pass expected_counts.keys() explicitly at the call site. Cosmetic only, no behavior change needed.
